mapper.select: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, NULLIF(o.position_side, 'BOTH'), o.position_side) AS position_side, CASE WHEN o.reduce_only = '1' THEN 1 WHEN o.reduce_only = '0' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS reduce_only, COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type) AS operation_type, NULL AS position_cycle_key, CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(soi.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(soi_client_role.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(dispatch_role.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(dispatch_client_role.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(pre_dispatch_role.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(pre_dispatch_client_role.source_conflict, 0) = 1 OR (e.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND e.operation_type <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (soi.fill_role IS NOT NULL AND soi.fill_role <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (soi_client_role.fill_role IS NOT NULL AND soi_client_role.fill_role <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (pre_dispatch_role.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_role.operation_type <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (dispatch_role.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_role.operation_type <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (dispatch_client_role.operation_type IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_client_role.operation_type <> COALESCE(soi.fill_role, soi_client_role.fill_role, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_client_role.operation_type, dispatch_role.operation_type, dispatch_client_role.operation_type, e.operation_type)) OR (soi.position_side IS NOT NULL AND soi.position_side <> COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, NULLIF(o.position_side, 'BOTH'), o.position_side)) OR (soi_client_role.position_side IS NOT NULL AND soi_client_role.position_side <> COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, NULLIF(o.position_side, 'BOTH'), o.position_side)) OR (pre_dispatch_role.position_side IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_role.position_side <> COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, NULLIF(o.position_side, 'BOTH'), o.position_side)) OR (pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side <> COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, NULLIF(o.position_side, 'BOTH'), o.position_side)) OR (o.position_side IN ('LONG', 'SHORT') AND o.position_side <> COALESCE(soi.position_side, soi_client_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side, pre_dispatch_client_role.position_side, o.position_side)) OR (soi.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND soi.exchange_side <> t.side) OR (soi_client_role.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND soi_client_role.exchange_side <> t.side) OR (pre_dispatch_role.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_role.exchange_side <> t.side) OR (pre_dispatch_client_role.exchange_side IS NOT NULL AND pre_dispatch_client_role.exchange_side <> t.side) OR (o.side IS NOT NULL AND o.side <> t.side) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS position_cycle_conflict, o.leverage_snapshot, o.price_tick_size_snapshot, o.post_fill_wallet_balance, o.post_fill_balance_at, qs.price_tick_size AS current_price_tick_size FROM ( SELECT * FROM quant_trade WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY trade_time, exchange_trade_id, id LIMIT 20001 ) t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id = t.credential_id AND o.symbol = t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_execution_record WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} AND operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id ) e ON e.credential_id = t.credential_id AND e.symbol = t.symbol AND e.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(position_side) AS position_side, MIN(fill_role) AS fill_role, MIN(exchange_side) AS exchange_side, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT position_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT fill_role) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT exchange_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT client_order_id) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_strategy_order_intent WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id ) soi ON soi.credential_id = t.credential_id AND soi.symbol = t.symbol AND soi.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, client_order_id, MIN(position_side) AS position_side, MIN(fill_role) AS fill_role, MIN(exchange_side) AS exchange_side, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT position_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT fill_role) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT exchange_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT exchange_order_id) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_strategy_order_intent WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} AND client_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, client_order_id ) soi_client_role ON soi_client_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND soi_client_role.symbol = t.symbol AND soi_client_role.client_order_id = o.client_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT client_order_id) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT idempotency_key) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} AND operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id ) dispatch_role ON dispatch_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND dispatch_role.symbol = t.symbol AND dispatch_role.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, client_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT exchange_order_id) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT idempotency_key) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} AND operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND client_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, client_order_id ) dispatch_client_role ON dispatch_client_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND dispatch_client_role.symbol = t.symbol AND dispatch_client_role.client_order_id = o.client_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.credential_id, p.symbol, d.exchange_order_id, MIN(p.operation_type) AS operation_type, MIN(p.position_side) AS position_side, MIN(p.exchange_side) AS exchange_side, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.operation_type) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.position_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.exchange_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT d.operation_type) <> 1 OR MIN(p.operation_type) <> MIN(d.operation_type) OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_order_id) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.idempotency_key) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_strategy_pre_dispatch_intent p JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket d ON d.credential_id = p.credential_id AND d.symbol = p.symbol AND d.idempotency_key = p.idempotency_key AND d.client_order_id = p.client_order_id WHERE p.credential_id IN #{id} AND p.symbol = #{symbol} AND p.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND d.exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.credential_id, p.symbol, d.exchange_order_id ) pre_dispatch_role ON pre_dispatch_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND pre_dispatch_role.symbol = t.symbol AND pre_dispatch_role.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.credential_id, p.symbol, p.client_order_id, MIN(p.operation_type) AS operation_type, MIN(p.position_side) AS position_side, MIN(p.exchange_side) AS exchange_side, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.operation_type) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.position_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.exchange_side) <> 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT d.operation_type) <> 1 OR MIN(p.operation_type) <> MIN(d.operation_type) OR COUNT(DISTINCT d.exchange_order_id) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT p.idempotency_key) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_conflict FROM quant_strategy_pre_dispatch_intent p JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket d ON d.credential_id = p.credential_id AND d.symbol = p.symbol AND d.idempotency_key = p.idempotency_key AND d.client_order_id = p.client_order_id WHERE p.credential_id IN #{id} AND p.symbol = #{symbol} AND p.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND d.client_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.credential_id, p.symbol, p.client_order_id ) pre_dispatch_client_role ON pre_dispatch_client_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND pre_dispatch_client_role.symbol = t.symbol AND pre_dispatch_client_role.client_order_id = o.client_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_symbol qs ON qs.symbol = t.symbol ORDER BY t.trade_time, t.exchange_trade_id, t.id LIMIT 20001

SELECT DISTINCT t.exchange_order_id FROM quant_trade t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id = t.credential_id AND o.symbol = t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id WHERE t.credential_id = #{credentialId} AND t.symbol = #{symbol} AND t.exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL AND ( o.id IS NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(o.position_side), '') IS NULL OR o.reduce_only IS NULL OR (o.id IS NOT NULL AND (o.client_order_id IS NULL OR o.client_order_id = CONCAT('EXCHANGE:', t.exchange_order_id))) ) ORDER BY t.exchange_order_id LIMIT #{limit}
